FN-KZE1AU-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 140
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Corley Ellis
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/30/2023
House Bill 140 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Administrative Office of
Courts (AOC) by an estimated $431,000 annually, once fully implemented, by transferring
juvenile probation services from Shelby County to the state, effective October 1, 2024. This bill
would further increase the obligations of AOC by an estimated $24,000 annually for travel
expenses of these personnel. This bill would correspondingly decrease obligations of Shelby
County by these same amounts.
The estimated amounts listed in the table below presume phase-in for financial support for this
program over a five-year period, as provided by current law:
Fiscal Year Increase Expense to AOC Total Expense to AOC
2025 - $235,430
2026 $86,112 $321,542
2027 $155,002 $390,432
2028 $210,113 $445,544
2029 $254,203 $489,633
2030 $430,560 $665,991
